minor.issue: FIXED — was returning 500 because _send_one_credential_email() did not return the dict from send_credential_email(); admin route then called r.get('sent') on None. Added missing `return` in orders_routes.py line 27.
No validation for non-positive price/discount/target_sales — e.g. lot quantity could be 0 or negative which then makes 'remaining' always 0. Consider Pydantic Field(gt=0).
When discount_type=percent and discount_value > 100, no clamp. Order accepts it and discount can exceed subtotal (clamped by max(0,...) later but discount value stored is misleading).

Returns 404 for inactive coupon but the request explicitly asked for 'returns 400 on expired or used-up'. Currently expired/used-up paths return 400 but inactive returns 404. Acceptable but spec ambiguous.
Lot availability check counts WAITING orders too — orphan WAITING orders (from failed PagBank) reduce remaining permanently. Consider TTL cleanup or excluding stale WAITING > 24h.
Still unauthenticated (only gated by ENABLE_DEV_SIMULATE_PAY env, default true). Same comment as iteration_1 — flag for prod.
Demotes user back to 'participante' but does NOT reset leader_id on existing orders; orders remain attributed to deleted leader. Cosmetic for reporting.
Loops sequentially via asyncio.to_thread per user — slow for large user bases. Acceptable for MVP.
Always returns 200 (good for no-enum-leak), but no rate limit — a bad actor can spam reset emails. Add per-IP rate limit before prod.

rca of the issue: POST /api/admin/orders-actions/{order_id}/resend-email returned 500 with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get'. Root cause: helper coroutine `_send_one_credential_email(cred, event)` in /app/backend/routes/orders_routes.py invoked `await send_credential_email(...)` (which returns {sent, id|reason}) but discarded the result — function had no return statement. The admin endpoint did `r = await _send_one_credential_email(...)` then `if r.get('sent')` → crash. Reproduction: create order, PUT /admin/orders-actions/{id}/status to PAID, then POST /admin/orders-actions/{id}/resend-email → 500. Mitigation applied: added `return` before `await send_credential_email(...)` so the helper propagates the dict result up. Test re-run: TestOrdersAdminActions::test_change_status_resend_pdf_courtesy now PASSES with 200 response body {sent: 0, total: 1} (sent=0 expected because Resend API key is intentionally unconfigured).
